build_ViLTImageEmbedding: build a ViLTImageEmbedding module to extract patch embeddings from images using a pretrained ViT model
build_ViLTTextEmbedding: build a ViLTTextEmbedding module to extract text embeddings from input IDs using a BERT-based encoder
build_ViLT_model: build a ViLT multimodal model that concatenates text and image embeddings and processes them through a shared transformer encoder
review_ViLT_forward: review the ViLT forward pass that concatenates text and image embeddings then feeds them through the transformer encoder
test_ViLT_get_attention_mask: test the ViLT get_attention_mask method that combines text and image attention masks for the transformer encoder
